Package ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.storage

Klasse FileBuildingStorageAPI

java.lang.Object
ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.storage.FileBuildingStorageAPI
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
BuildingStorageAPI
public class FileBuildingStorageAPI extends Object implements BuildingStorageAPI
File-based implementation of the BuildingStorageAPI interface.

This implementation uses a JSON file to store and retrieve building data. It leverages the JsonReader utility for reading and writing JSON data.

Error handling: IO exceptions during reading return an empty list, while exceptions during writing are propagated as runtime exceptions.

Thread-safety: This implementation is stateless (after construction) and therefore thread-safe.
